name: renodx
one_liner: A modding toolkit that upgrades old PC games' graphics — adding HDR, better lighting, and modern visual effects — without needing the original developers to update the game.
buyer: A retro/classic PC gaming enthusiast or small modding studio who wants to sell or share visually-remastered versions of beloved older games.
business_use_cases: A modding creator builds and sells premium HDR/ray-tracing visual packs for popular classic games via Patreon or Ko-fi.
A YouTuber builds a channel around 'this old game with modern graphics' videos, monetized through ads and sponsorships.
A game preservation group uses it to make older titles visually appealing to new players, growing interest in a legacy title.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid, ready-to-install visual remaster packs for specific popular older games, sold directly or via Patreon tiers.
Take commissions to build custom shader/visual mods for specific games requested by fan communities.

steal_this: This weekend, pick one beloved older game, build a before/after HDR remaster demo video with this toolkit, and launch a Patreon for ongoing mod packs.
